directory.tech_details_intro: Technical details for everyday web users and open-source enthusiasts:

usages.photos: Photo sharing with no toxic algorithm

qlub.desc: Regional microblogging and local discussions without amplification algorithms. 100% Quebec hosting.

mastodon-quebec.desc: General Quebec Fediverse server; adheres to the Mastodon Server Covenant with active moderation.

pataterie.desc: Community, artistic and cultural space rooted in Montreal's local reality.

jasette-facil.desc: Promoting digital commons, public debates, and software sovereignty by FACiL.

pds-stockage-quebec.desc: Personal Data Server (PDS) hosting your Bluesky identity and keys outside the United States.

cosocial.desc: Cooperative social utility; democratic member governance (one member, one vote).

mstdn-ca.desc: Major Canadian Fediverse community hub; strict adherence to kindness and inclusion.

pixelfed-ca.desc: Major sovereign photography community; hosted in Quebec (Beauharnois) with automatic EXIF GPS stripping.

pxlfd-ca.desc: Alternative, creative photography sharing without tracking or AI exploitation. #FediPact signatory.

forumsdulibre-quebec.desc: Civic deliberation, open-source mutual help, and public policy debates on digital sovereignty and Law 25.

lemmy-ca.desc: The leading Canadian open forum and link aggregator: thematic communities, news, and civic life.

canal-facile.desc: Civic conferences, educational videos, and panels without behavioral tracking or targeted ads.

peertube-diro.desc: University course materials, computer science research, and open scientific lectures.

beluga-convo.desc: End-to-end encrypted team messaging on dedicated bare-metal servers in Quebec. Strict Law 25 compliance.

matrix-koumbit.desc: Secure coordination rooms operated by a worker-managed solidarity cooperative for over 20 years.

passerelles.desc: Civic professional networking, communities of practice, and project matchmaking for social innovation.

babillard-encommun.desc: Shared, customizable community boards to discover and promote events, activities, and calls to action without commercial algorithms.

ecosystem.title: Where are we migrating to?
ecosystem.subtitle: Sovereign social networks are not algorithmic prisons: they are decentralized, ad-free, and locally hosted.
ecosystem.fediverse_desc: Thousands of independent, interconnected servers. Just like email, you can follow anyone regardless of their home server.
ecosystem.bluesky_desc: An open architecture providing total choice of algorithms and full portability of your account and followers.
ecosystem.matrix_desc: End-to-end encrypted, sovereign, and self-hostable communication protocols to replace closed big tech messengers.
ecosystem.canada_instances: Canadian-hosted nodes and community instances ready upon unlock!

zero_knowledge.title: Why Zero-Knowledge matters?
zero_knowledge.p1: On Facebook or X, your relationship graph is the primary commodity being sold. At DigitalPact.ca, we reject that model.
zero_knowledge.p2: Your invite link contains a secret key in the URL fragment (#k=...). This fragment never travels over the web to our servers. Your friends increment a blind counter without ever revealing who they are to each other or to us.
